html:
The Yambina were an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, whose lands lay inland, some distance west of Mackay.

Little is recorded about them. Linguists count their speech among the dialects of the Biri language. Their neighbours were the Barna, Wangan, Yangga and Miyan. Sheep and cattle runs spread over this country in the 1860s.
sum: The Yambina were an Aboriginal Australian people of central Queensland, whose lands lay inland, some distance west of Mackay.
